name: Revenue Reconciliation and Leak Audit
description: Match a local invoice book to payments, refunds, and chargebacks. Age the open items and separate leaks, collections, overpayments, and cleared cash.

parameters.content:
## Books
Each row is an invoice plus the cash, refunds, and chargebacks applied to it. This is a closed sample, not a live ledger.

## Lanes
Chargeback, overpaid, collections (open and older than 45 days), still-open, and cleared.
